quotes: App force closes whenever I try to apply a promo code on the latest release.

recommendation.title: Deploy Emergency Hotfix for Checkout & Launch Crashes
recommendation.recommendation: Isolate payment controller and session lifecycle memory leaks introduced in v2.4. Roll back checkout bundle or patch Apple Pay SDK crash immediately.
recommendation.rationale: Category priority scored 91/100 with 41 negative reports (+3700% recent surge) and a severe 4.4/5 severity rating.
recommendation.expected_impact: Reduce app crash rate by 85% and restore abandoned checkout revenue.

quotes: Difficult to cancel subscription. Had to navigate 4 confirmation pages and call support.
Invoice lacked proper VAT breakdown required for business accounting.
Unexpected annual auto-renewal charge occurred without any reminder email beforehand.

recommendation.title: Add Transparent Renewal Reminders & One-Click Cancel
recommendation.recommendation: Send automatic 7-day email reminders prior to annual subscription renewals. Provide a clear self-serve cancellation flow in user account settings.
recommendation.rationale: Users report unexpected charges with a 3.7/5 severity score. Eliminating dark patterns reduces chargeback disputes.
recommendation.expected_impact: Cut disputed billing charges by 70% and rebuild user trust.

quotes: Took over a week to get a response to my support ticket regarding a warranty claim.
Waited 45 minutes on live chat only to be transferred and disconnected.
Waited 45 minutes on live chat only to be transferred and disconnected.

recommendation.title: Refactor Chatbot Escalation & Support Routing
recommendation.recommendation: Reduce chatbot loop threshold from 3 turns to 1 turn before human handoff. Add instant callback options during peak live-chat queues.
recommendation.rationale: Customer support accounts for 19 negative touchpoints with wait times and chat loops as top drivers.
recommendation.expected_impact: Reduce average queue handle time by 35% and boost resolution satisfaction.

quotes: Package arrived 4 days later than promised with zero tracking updates in between.
Package arrived 4 days later than promised with zero tracking updates in between.

recommendation.title: Audit Carrier SLA & Automate Tracking Notifications
recommendation.recommendation: Implement webhook tracking updates for courier status shifts. Alert customers proactively on shipment milestones to deflect support inquiries.
recommendation.rationale: 17 shipping complaints logged (49% of shipping feedback), predominantly driven by tracking latency.
recommendation.expected_impact: Deflect 40% of 'Where is my order?' support tickets and improve post-purchase CSAT.

recommendation.title: Address Core Friction in Product Quality
recommendation.recommendation: Conduct usability and QA audit on Product Quality. Review top 12 customer reports and prioritize recurring root causes in next sprint.
recommendation.rationale: Score of 30/100 driven by 12 negative items out of 40 total feedback entries.
recommendation.expected_impact: Expected 25-30% reduction in negative product quality mentions within 30 days.
